---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Melissa Gonzalez- Ortiz"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
average_births <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(average_births, aes(
  x = date_of_month,
  y = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.name),
  fill = mean_births
)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(month.name)) +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = "Month", fill = "Mean births")
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  filter(
    month == 12,
    date_of_month == 25 | date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)
  ) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_average = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline = 100 * christmas_births / surrounding_average,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Christmas births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = 100 * residuals(births_model) / mean(births))

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = make_date(2001, month, date_of_month))

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(calendar_date %in% as.Date(c(
    "2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-12-24", "2001-12-25"
  ))) |>
  mutate(
    holiday = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ "New Year's Day",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ "Independence Day",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ "Christmas Eve",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ "Christmas Day"
    ),
    label_date = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ calendar_date + days(20),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ calendar_date + days(2),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ calendar_date - days(18),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ calendar_date - days(12)
    ),
    label_y = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ -20,
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ -17,
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ -24,
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ -48
    )
  )

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray60") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = holiday_dips) +
  geom_segment(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(xend = label_date, yend = label_y),
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = holiday),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean birth-count residual (% of overall mean)"
  )
```
